Backend API Reference

The SQRL backend reference documents the Python modules that power the application, including its HTTP routes, validation schemas, domain services, storage adapters, and machine-learning components.

Use the sections below to navigate by responsibility. Related modules are combined into category pages—for example, all prompt generators are presented together under Prompt Components instead of appearing as separate pages with long fully qualified titles. Route modules describe the application boundary, service modules contain business operations, and supporting modules provide the shared infrastructure used across the platform. The pages are generated directly from the backend source and include available classes, methods, attributes, signatures, and inheritance relationships.

For endpoint-oriented testing and request examples, run the application and open the interactive OpenAPI reference at http://localhost:8000/docs.

Browse the generated backend reference by responsibility rather than by file.
